boundary: The compact package reproduces downstream summaries from selected full-precision intermediates. Original raw-read quantification, full-matrix rank construction, reference preprocessing and FASTA search require upstream inputs and are not repeated by the compact rerun. Recipes preserve those calculations but are not standalone without the documented full inputs.
